findings.entity: Coins held in both hands above the cups
findings.description: After lifting coins out of the front cup (00:02.25), the near hand holds a coin at the cup rim from about 00:03 to 00:09.75. From 00:03.50 the far hand also holds a coin at another cup rim. Throughout, the camera pulls back from close-up to a wide side view. Neither coin is ever dropped, inserted or set down, and neither hand withdraws. Over about 7 s of continuous footage the placing motion starts but never completes and is never visibly interrupted. It plays as an endless hover loop, not as a placement with an outcome.
